dialogue.origin: こんばんは！今日はよろしくお願いします！
dialogue.content: Good evening! Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening, thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: 時間前ですがはじめますか？？
dialogue.content: It's a bit early, but shall we get started?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: わかりました！でははじめますねー。
dialogue.content: Understood! Let's get started then.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは！初めまして、相談員です。今日はどうされましたか？？
dialogue.content: Good evening! Nice to meet you, I'm a counselor. What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: こんばんはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening, thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: The pleasure is mine.

dialogue.origin: 妹が許せないのです
dialogue.content: I can't forgive my younger sister.

dialogue.origin: 妹が許せないのですね。。
dialogue.content: You feel you can't forgive your sister...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何があったのかお話しできますか？？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me what happened?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 妹と絶縁しています
dialogue.content: I'm estranged from my sister.

dialogue.origin: ええはい。
dialogue.content: Yes, I see.

dialogue.origin: それはとても悲しいですよね。。
dialogue.content: That must be very sad.

dialogue.origin: そうでもないです
dialogue.content: Not really.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。どうしてそう思われるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is that so... What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: ここ数年妹が病気で入院しているのですが、先月余命宣告されました
dialogue.content: My sister has been hospitalized with an illness for the past few years, and last month she was given a terminal prognosis.

dialogue.origin: ええはい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 親戚が知らせてくれました
dialogue.content: A relative told me.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 妹のお見舞いには、一度も行っていません
dialogue.content: I haven't visited her in the hospital even once.

dialogue.origin: 一度も行かれてないんですね。。
dialogue.content: You haven't gone even once...

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: なんで行かれなかったのですか？
dialogue.content: May I ask why you haven't gone?

dialogue.origin: 妹は、母が施設に入所させるのに反対でした
dialogue.content: My sister was against putting our mother in a care facility.

dialogue.origin: そのために、、、
dialogue.content: Because of that...

dialogue.origin: ええはい。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 私は、母の介護をしていました
dialogue.content: I was taking care of our mother.

dialogue.origin: そして
dialogue.content: And then...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 恋人の海外赴任が決まり、母を施設に入所させて、結婚することにしました、
dialogue.content: My partner got an overseas assignment, so I decided to put my mother in a facility and get married.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 存命だった父も賛成してくれました
dialogue.content: Our father, who was still alive at the time, also agreed.

dialogue.origin: しかし、妹が大反対しました
dialogue.content: However, my sister was strongly against it.

dialogue.origin: ええはい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 私が結婚のために、母を入所しようとすると、激しく起こり、私を罵倒しました
dialogue.content: When I tried to put our mother in a facility so I could get married, she became furious and verbally abused me.

dialogue.origin: でも、
dialogue.content: But...

dialogue.origin: ええはい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私が結婚をしようとすると、妹は、私の結婚を破断にしました
dialogue.content: When I was about to get married, my sister broke up my engagement.

dialogue.origin: 妹は、母を入所させたくないのです
dialogue.content: My sister didn't want our mother to be put in a facility.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、、それは本当にお辛いですよね、、、
dialogue.content: I see... that must have been truly painful for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ずっとあなたは頑張られていたのに本当に悲しいですよね。。。
dialogue.content: It's truly heartbreaking, especially since you've been trying so hard all this time.

dialogue.origin: HAI
dialogue.content: YES.

dialogue.origin: だから妹さんがどうしても許せない・・・それは本当に憎くて仕方ないですよね。。
dialogue.content: So that's why you absolutely can't forgive your sister... It makes sense that you would feel such intense resentment.

dialogue.origin: はい、ソレダケデハ　ナイデス
dialogue.content: Yes, but that's not all.

dialogue.origin: すみません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: ええはい。お聞かせください。
dialogue.content: It's alright. Please, tell me.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ大丈夫ですよ。。
dialogue.content: No, no, it's okay...

dialogue.origin: 母が、要介護のとき、妹は2人目の出産で、介護は手伝いませんでっした。無理もないのは分かります。
dialogue.content: When our mother needed care, my sister was having her second child and didn't help with the caregiving. I understand it couldn't be helped.

dialogue.origin: ええはい。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: あの、一人で話ししていたので、どうぞ、進めてくださいませ
dialogue.content: Um, I've just been talking by myself, so please, go ahead and guide the conversation.

dialogue.origin: お気になさらないでいいですよ。このお時間はあなたのお時間なのでどうぞお話しください。
dialogue.content: Please don't worry about it. This is your time, so please feel free to talk.

dialogue.origin: もう、話をすることは、ほとんど、ありません
dialogue.content: I don't really have much more to say.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。わかりました。。
dialogue.content: I see. I understand...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ずっと頑張られていたんですね・・
dialogue.content: You've been trying so hard for a very long time...

dialogue.origin: そうなのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: 私はお聴きした感じそう思いますよ。。
dialogue.content: From what I've heard, I believe so.

dialogue.origin: それに
dialogue.content: And also,

dialogue.origin: 妹さんにも気を使ってらっしゃったのでとてもお優しい方だと思いますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You were also considerate of your sister, so I think you are a very kind person. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 気は使っていません
dialogue.content: I wasn't being considerate.

dialogue.origin: すいません言い方が悪かったです。あなたの時間を削ってまでずっと頑張られていたのでとてもお優しい方だと感じましたがいかがでしょうか？？
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, that was a poor choice of words. You sacrificed so much of your own time and kept trying so hard, and I felt that makes you a very compassionate person. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: I suppose so.

dialogue.origin: ちなみにこの出来事は最近のお話でしょうか？
dialogue.content: By the way, is this something that happened recently?

dialogue.origin: 最近の話ですが、絶縁になってから7年が立ちます
dialogue.content: This is a recent development, but it's been seven years since we became estranged.

dialogue.origin: 7年間、一度もあっていません
dialogue.content: We haven't met once in seven years.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね・・最後はどんなお話をして会わなくなったのですか？
dialogue.content: I see... What was the last conversation you had before you stopped seeing each other?

dialogue.origin: 結婚破断にされて、母の介護も手伝わずに、何も会話していません。喧嘩で終わりました
dialogue.content: After she broke my engagement and didn't help with our mother's care, we didn't talk at all. It ended in a fight.

dialogue.origin: 妹は、先程言いましたが、余命宣告を受けています
dialogue.content: As I mentioned earlier, my sister has been given a terminal prognosis.

dialogue.origin: 喧嘩別れが最後だったのですね。。それはとても許せませんよね。あなたはずっと頑張っていたのに。。。
dialogue.content: So the last time you spoke, you parted on bad terms... That must be so hard to forgive, especially after you had been trying so hard for so long.

dialogue.origin: ええはい
dialogue.content: Yes, I see.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 最後まで、妹に会わないと、夫や親戚にどう思われるかも、気になります
dialogue.content: I'm also concerned about what my husband and relatives will think if I don't see my sister before the end.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。許せなくても会いに行かなければ周りの方の反応が怖いですよね。。。
dialogue.content: I see. Even if you can't forgive her, it's scary to think about how others might react if you don't go see her.

dialogue.origin: 怖いというより、どうしたら良いのかなと、思いまして
dialogue.content: It's not so much that I'm scared, but I'm just not sure what I should do.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。では今のあなたはどうしたいですか？
dialogue.content: I see. So, what do you want to do right now?

dialogue.origin: 妹さんは余命宣告を受けていますが、介護もせず、結婚を破断にされたとゆう事ですが、
dialogue.content: Your sister has been told she doesn't have long to live, but she also didn't help with caregiving and broke up your engagement...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お会いできます？
dialogue.content: Do you feel able to meet her?

dialogue.origin: わからないので、悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I don't know, and that's why I'm struggling.

dialogue.origin: 妹に会わないでいて、公開しないのか・・・？
dialogue.content: If I don't see my sister, will I regret it...?

dialogue.origin: 後悔です
dialogue.content: I meant regret.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、、後悔するのかが分からないので悩みますよね。。
dialogue.content: Right... You're struggling because you don't know if you'll have regrets.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 葬式はどうしたらよいかとかも
dialogue.content: And also what to do about the funeral and things like that.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、、葬儀やなどもありますのでなおさら考えますよね。。
dialogue.content: I understand... With the funeral and everything else, it gives you even more to think about.

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: では例えなんですが何もしなくていいとなったらあなたはどうされますか？？
dialogue.content: Well then, as a thought experiment, if you were told you didn't have to do anything, what would you do?

dialogue.origin: 迷います、悩みます
dialogue.content: I'd still be torn and struggle with it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、難しいですよね。。
dialogue.content: Right, it's a difficult decision...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: では今の妹さんの状態を知って、何か思いますか？？
dialogue.content: Knowing your sister's current condition, what comes up for you?

dialogue.origin: 妹が許せないと思ってしまいます
dialogue.content: I find myself thinking that I can't forgive my sister.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらよいですか
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。。どうしても許せませんし憎いですよね。
dialogue.content: I understand. It's only natural that you can't forgive her and feel resentment.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんです、そう思ってしまうのです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right—that's how I end up feeling.

dialogue.origin: とても悩みますし、考えますよね。。では最後、と思ってみてはいかがですか？
dialogue.content: It's something you agonize and think a lot about. In that case, how about trying to think of it as the last time?

dialogue.origin: 会うと言うことですか？
dialogue.content: Do you mean I should go and see her?

dialogue.origin: 妹さんを観れるのが最後と考えてみてはいかがですか？？
dialogue.content: How about thinking of it as the last time you'll be able to see your sister?

dialogue.origin: はい、どうなのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Yes... I'm not sure.

dialogue.origin: やっぱり会わなければいけないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do I really have to see her after all?

dialogue.origin: 憎くて許せなかったお相手がもういなくなる、って考えたらどう思われますか？
dialogue.content: How does it feel to imagine that the person you've resented and couldn't forgive will soon no longer be here?

dialogue.origin: そうゆうことはありませんよ。会うか会わないかはあなたが決めるものですから・・
dialogue.content: Not at all. Whether to see her or not is for you to decide.

dialogue.origin: 会っても、会わなくても、誰もどう思わないですか
dialogue.content: Whether I see her or not, will no one think anything of it?

dialogue.origin: 思われる方もいますが、あなたの事を理解している方ならあなたの考えを理解してくれると思いますよ。
dialogue.content: Some people might think something, but those who understand you will understand your decision.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: すいません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: お時間だいぶんと過ぎてしまいました。申し訳ございません。
dialogue.content: We've gone quite a bit over our time. I do apologize.

dialogue.origin: いいえ、大丈夫です
dialogue.content: No, it's alright.

dialogue.origin: 一応終了となります。今日はありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: This concludes our session for now. Thank you for your time today!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 初めてお聴きしたケースだったのでたくさん気付きや発見がありました！
dialogue.content: This was the first time I'd heard a case like this, so I had many insights and realizations.

dialogue.origin: そうですか
dialogue.content: Is that so?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 時間の方すいませんでした。また一緒にできたらその時はお願いします！
dialogue.content: I'm sorry about the time again. If we have the chance to work together again, I look forward to it!

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Likewise, I look forward to it.

dialogue.origin: では終了しますねー。
dialogue.content: Well then, I'll end the session now.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.
